observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' carries urgency-as-worry — a directive to purge knowledge, performed with heightened arousal and negative valence.
Categorical imperative 'Remove all knowledge' extends the same urgent purgative directive — high arousal, negative valence, alarm at the prospect of residual knowledge.
Flat negation 'never calibrated it' settles into low-arousal resignation — a weary corrective closing the prior urgency, not re-escalating it.
